purpose: Reviewed reapplication of candidate allocation/layout optimizations and a narrower native-key publication priority scope
kept: original body/comment span structure and all CharacterStyle.updateDrawState semantics
same SDK/model/YAML and fixed source APKs
revised: One scratch TextPaint per traversal, reset from the base paint before each later run
Lazy index badge preserving default style and parent layout params
Skip identical Flexbox minWidth/flexGrow assignments based on actual values
Display-priority scope contains Native.key/result publication, excludes logs/forwarded-key bookkeeping
not_restored: Cached string reuse for arbitrary mutable CharSequence input

screen.block: Four-treatment Williams square, all products once per block; each product occupies every ordinal position once and each directed neighbor pair once per complete square
screen.unit: One current-minus-baseline delta per block, 4 paired observations per contrast per VM

selection.exclusion: A cold metric has positive paired medians in both VMs and at least 3 of 4 blocks slower in each VM
selection.rule: Use the first nonexcluded product in the fixed preference; never choose the lowest observed median; no confirmation if all are excluded

confirmation.balance: Three ABBA and three BAAB blocks per VM
confirmation.unit: Mean of two candidate processes minus mean of two baseline processes within each ABBA/BAAB block

requirements: All per-product source/build/APK/native/JVM/Android correctness gates pass
Independent confirmation has at least one cold metric negative median and at least 5 of 6 blocks faster in BOTH VMs
Neither cold metric has positive median in BOTH VMs
No warm metric has positive medians and at least 4 of 6 slower blocks in BOTH VMs
promotion_policy.note: These are conservative engineering gates, not a formal statistical noninferiority guarantee; retain all raw signs/ranges and all unfavorable outcomes; no P95/phone/Release/general speedup claims

rules: One fixed screen and at most one independent confirmation
Never rerun accepted samples to replace unfavorable results
Preserve setup failures and APK/probe/host/signer/SDK hashes
Do not change default branch or unrelated user refactor branch
